categories_thin: Physicians: East Brunswick has hundreds of doctors, most hospital- or system-affiliated (Hackensack Meridian, RWJBarnabas, Axia, Advocare). Only clearly independent practices were listed; a full physician census was not feasible and would mostly be ineligible.
Barbers: only four barber shops turned up in directories, fewer than expected for a town this size.

Yoga/pilates: only a handful of independent studios found; several local options appear to be gyms or chain studios (Club Pilates, BODYROK, Jersey Strong, LA Fitness, Planet Fitness, Crunch) which were excluded.
Dental specialists (periodontics, oral surgery, endodontics) appear mostly as single listings; addresses often not published on the aggregator.
caveats: Many dental entries come from a single Google-derived aggregator (DentistsRanked) that ranks 64 East Brunswick clinics; those need verification and several may be the same office under a practice and doctor name.

Flagged as likely chains/franchises and excluded: Aspen Dental, Supercuts, JCPenney Salon, Massage Envy, Hand & Stone, HairClub, Tiger Schulmann's, Banfield, VCA Edgebrook, Club Pilates, BODYROK, Crunch, LA Fitness, Planet Fitness, Jersey Strong, Kessler Rehabilitation, Trinity Rehab, Hackensack Meridian Rehabilitation, Children's Specialized Hospital.
Brunswick Hills OB/GYN and OB/GYN of East Brunswick are Axia Women's Health practices; Advocare Mid-Jersey Pediatrics is part of a large physician network. Included but flagged for exclusion review.
Several Route 18 listings are suites inside large strip centers; suite numbers are as published.
Addresses marked Unknown were not exposed by the directory snippet; triage should look these up.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, Superpages, Zocdoc, Cylex, ChamberofCommerce.com and Manta all returned 403/Cloudflare blocks from this environment.
DentistsRanked clinic detail pages rate-limited (HTTP 429) after the list page, so per-clinic addresses could not be pulled.
Google Maps shows a limited results view without sign-in (4 visible results per query), so it could not be used as a bulk census.
Overpass/OSM API returned 502 and was abandoned per brief.
East Brunswick Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory is JavaScript-loaded and could not be read.
Township of East Brunswick site has no public business license directory found.
